purpose: Candidate source registry for Telangana Police SI / Constable previous-year question papers. Registration records intent to pursue a source; it is not a claim that any paper has been acquired or read.
blocked_reason: Network egress from this environment is restricted to an allowlist that does not include any paper-hosting host, and web search returned no content. No source URL could be verified from here, so no source is registered. Exact response recorded in attempts[] and in source_material/pyq_raw/RETRIEVAL_LOG.md.

eligible_source_types.OFFICIAL_PUBLICATION: A paper (or answer key) served by TGPRB / TSLPRB itself, or its official archive. Highest evidence value but, where the board does not publish solved papers, may not exist.
eligible_source_types.COACHING_COPY: A coaching institute's scan or transcription of a paper, or its 'solved papers' compilation. This is the realistic route for most previous years. Recorded as a coaching copy, never relabelled as board-issued.
eligible_source_types.CANDIDATE_RECALL: A paper reconstructed from candidates' memory. Lowest evidence value; must be labelled as reconstruction and cross-checked against at least one other source before any question is classified.

eligibility_rules: A source qualifies only if it can be tied to a specific Telangana Police SI or Constable written examination paper, with a year and phase.
A paper must be complete or its incompleteness recorded with a numerator/denominator.
Every question drawn from a source must record an answer_source: OFFICIAL_KEY, COACHING_KEY, or UNVERIFIED.
A coaching-site copy of an official document is never eligible here as an official document; it may be a legitimate PYQ source, recorded with source_type COACHING_COPY.
